rules.title: A report must not move the user's layout
rules.text: A report opens on a surface of its own and never splits, moves or resizes what the user was reading: `ViewColumn.Beside` with one group open, or `sbuffer`, halves the window someone was working in and costs more attention than the finding is worth.

judgement.question: Does this call open a surface in a way that splits, moves or resizes what the user is already looking at, rather than showing the report without disturbing the current layout?

criteria.true: it splits the window, takes a beside-column, or otherwise moves what the user was reading
criteria.false: it is a comment or a test, or the call reuses the current window or a float without moving anything
